title: The Effects of Sika Deer Antler Peptides on 3T3-L1 Preadipocytes and C57BL/6 Mice via Activating AMPK Signaling and Gut Microbiota.
authors: Sun, Tong; Hao, Zezhuang; Meng, Fanying; Li, Xue; Wang, Yihua; Zhu, Haowen; Li, Yong; Ding, Yuling
one_liner_zh: 该文研究梅花鹿鹿茸肽的抗肥胖作用及机制，涉及细胞与小鼠实验、AMPK信号通路和肠道菌群，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: (1) Background: To explore the anti-obesity effects and mechanisms of sika deer velvet antler peptides (sVAP) on 3T3-L1 preadipocytes and in high-fat diet (HFD)-induced obese mice. (2) Methods: sVAP fractions of different molecular weights were obtained via enzymatic hydrolysis and ultrafiltration. Their anti-lipid effects on 3T3-L1 cells were assessed with Oil Red O staining. The optimal fraction was tested in HFD-induced obese C57BL/6 mice to explore anti-obesity mechanisms. Peptide purification used LC-MS/MS, followed by sequence analysis and molecular docking for activity prediction. (3) Results: The peptide with the best anti-obesity activity was identified as sVAP-3K (</=3 kDa). sVAP-3K reduced lipid content and proliferation in 3T3-L1 cells, improved lipid profiles and ameliorated adipocyte degeneration in HFD mice, promoted the growth of beneficial gut microbiota, and maintained lipid metabolism. Additionally, sVAP-3K activated the AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) signaling pathway, regulating adipogenic transcription factors. sVAP-3K exhibited ten major components (peak area >/= 1.03 x 10(8)), with four of the most active components being newly discovered natural oligopeptides: RVDPVNFKL (m/z 363.21371), GGEFTPVLQ (m/z 474.24643), VDPENFRL (m/z 495.25735), and VDPVNFK (m/z 818.44043). (4) Conclusion: This study identifies four novel oligopeptides in sVAP-3K as key components for anti-obesity effects, offering new evidence for developing natural weight-loss drugs from sika deer velvet.
abstract_zh: (1) 背景：探讨梅花鹿鹿茸多肽（sVAP）对3T3-L1前脂肪细胞及高脂饮食（HFD）诱导肥胖小鼠的抗肥胖作用及其机制。(2) 方法：通过酶解和超滤获得不同分子量的sVAP组分，采用油红O染色评估其对3T3-L1细胞的抗脂质作用。将最优组分用于HFD诱导的肥胖C57BL/6小鼠，以探索抗肥胖机制。多肽纯化采用LC-MS/MS，随后进行序列分析和分子对接以预测活性。(3) 结果：具有最佳抗肥胖活性的多肽被鉴定为sVAP-3K（≤3 kDa）。sVAP-3K降低了3T3-L1细胞的脂质含量和增殖，改善了HFD小鼠的脂质谱并减轻了脂肪细胞变性，促进了有益肠道菌群的生长，并维持了脂质代谢。此外，sVAP-3K激活了AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）信号通路，调节脂肪生成转录因子。sVAP-3K表现出十个主要组分（峰面积≥1.03×10^8），其中四个最具活性的组分为新发现的天然寡肽：RVDPVNFKL（m/z 363.21371）、GGEFTPVLQ（m/z 474.24643）、VDPENFRL（m/z 495.25735）和VDPVNFK（m/z 818.44043）。(4) 结论：本研究鉴定出sVAP-3K中的四种新型寡肽为抗肥胖作用的关键组分，为开发基于梅花鹿鹿茸的天然减肥药物提供了新证据。
